final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT r.ordervault AS ref, o.orderflow AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow), s2 AS (SELECT status, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1 GROUP BY status), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ref AS ref, s1.status AS status, s1.cnt AS cnt, (s1.cnt * 1.0) / s2.total AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.status = s2.status COLLATE BINARY), s4 AS (SELECT status, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM s3 GROUP BY status) SELECT s3.ref, s3.status, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s3.status = s4.status COLLATE BINARY WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
